title: C4 diagrams: open the tile
description: Open the C4 tile as it was, at a diagram you showed before (its item id), or at one in the project's docs (its file and heading, as docs/hla.md#containers). To draw a new diagram, use c4__show.

diagram.description: The item id of a diagram you showed with c4__show, or a docs diagram's id (its file, #, its heading as a slug: docs/hla.md#containers), to open at it
